Hi Julie —

Thanks again for the time earlier. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a draft SOW that aligns with the scope we reviewed. To keep momentum, I sketched a 90-day sprint with key milestones, owners, and target dates. High-level highlights: 

- Phase 0 (Pre-provisioning, week 0–1): PO + legal signoff, account provisioning details collected (Procurement + Aditya)
- Phase 1 (Platform access & basic integration, weeks 2–4): API keys, VPC/VPN handoff (CS owner)
- Phase 2 (Model onboarding & validation, weeks 5–8): test prompts, latency/cost baselines (Engineering + Customer SME)
- Phase 3 (Pilot & go-live prep, weeks 9–12): production cutover window + rollback plan

Please review the attached MAP for explicit owner assignments and acceptance criteria. Two asks from our side:
1) Confirm who on your side will be the procurement contact for the PO (we'll need billing contact + tax info).
2) Can you review the milestones and flag any timing conflicts? If the proposed week 2 start is tight, tell us a preferred start week and we will re-calendar.

Attachments: HAL-4921-MAP-v1.pdf (MAP, 2 pages); SOW-draft-HaloHealth.docx (SOW draft, 3 pages)

If it helps, I can set a 30-minute cadence call next week to lock owners and dates.

Thanks —
